title: Over a separably closed field connected implies geometrically connected
statement: Let $k$ be a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed] and let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Then $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if and only if $X$ is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme].
